source.title: Forebears Guinea forenames and surnames frequency tables

names.notes: Public frequency tables were used to seed localized given names and surnames. This is not an official civil registry export; this GEO remains separate from guinea_conakry by product decision.

phones.notes: ITU lists Guinea under country code +224. Public dialling data and historical product assumptions use 6-leading mobile-like numbers; exact current mobile allocation blocks were not directly extracted here, so generation remains constrained synthetic data.

source.title: UPU General Addressing Issues: Guinea postcode notes

locations.notes: UPU general addressing material and public postal examples indicate Guinea addresses are commonly locality/BP-oriented rather than reliably postcode-driven. Conakry uses the public 001 BP example shape; other BP prefixes and streets are synthetic review seeds.

source.title: IRB Canada: Guinea national identity card characteristics

national_identity_card_number.notes: Public source confirms national identity card characteristics and requirements, but no official public number grammar, checksum or semantic digit rule was found. Generated value is a synthetic placeholder.

passport.notes: PRADO confirms Guinea ordinary passport entries. Public listings do not confirm the visible passport-number grammar; generation remains template-only synthetic.
